Direct edition: one-time $39.99 for one Mac, $20 per additional Mac (up to five); rent-to-own four payments of $9.99. Marketplace plans differ.
facts.excerpt: For unlimited cleanup and organizing, a one-time purchase costs $39.99 for one Mac plus $20 for each additional Mac, up to five, with every Mint 1.x update included, and you can keep using every version you install. Rent to Own covers one Mac with four monthly payments of $9.99 ($39.96 total before tax); the fourth payment ends scheduled charges and Mint is yours. Mac App Store and Setapp have separate plans.

summary.method: Read-only public browser DOM for AlternativeTo; official pages fetched over ordinary HTTPS; selected JavaScript-rendered official pages read in owned browser tab. Excerpts whitespace-normalized. No installation, testing, accounts, cleanup or purchases.

statusMeaning.verified: Baseline identity, core function, platforms, explicitly documented licence, pricing and availability observation have source excerpts; not exhaustive or publication approval.
statusMeaning.partial: Some official product facts supported; missing fields, ambiguity or conflicts remain.
statusMeaning.blocked: No substantive official core-function proof obtained; access errors/empty/parked sources retained.

limitations: Unknown fields are unverified, never No.
Vendor marketing establishes documented claims, not measured performance or safety.
Download links establish an official offer, not a tested download or continuing development.
Platform values are the scope explicitly observed, not proof that unlisted platforms are unsupported.
Commercial licence terms remain unverified unless explicitly quoted. A pricing model is not a software licence.
Alias review compared names and official identities across the full 150-record manifest; no vendor-level merge without explicit official support.
